entries.legalName: Paddle.com Market Limited (contracting entity); Paddle.com Inc. (DPA processor / Data Importer); Paddle Payments Limited; Paddle.com Canada Ltd
entries.service: Payment processing and Merchant of Record billing
entries.purpose: Process subscription payments for paid plans, calculate/collect/remit VAT and sales tax, issue invoices and fiscal documentation on Postqron's behalf
entries.countryOfEstablishment: United Kingdom (Paddle.com Market Limited); Ireland (Paddle Payments Limited); United States (Paddle.com Inc.); Canada (Paddle.com Canada Ltd)
entries.countryOfProcessing: Not disclosed on Paddle's official pages; Paddle states data may be processed by any of its group entities
entries.note: Paddle also acts as Merchant of Record and independent seller for the payment transaction itself (see the Terms of Service); this registry entry covers Paddle's role in processing Postqron account/billing data, not Paddle's own capacity as MoR contracting party to the end customer. Paddle's DPA text references a legacy sub-processor list page ('learn.profitwell.com') that appears outdated; Paddle's Trust Center sub-processor list (https://trust.paddle.com/subprocessors) could not be read by automated fetch and its contents are not independently verified.

entries.purpose: Host Postqron's application, database, object storage and backups
entries.countryOfProcessing: European Union / European Economic Area, confirmed EU-only processing when an EU server location is selected; Hetzner also offers non-EEA locations (United States, Singapore) as a customer choice not selected for Postqron's production hosting, consistent with Postqron's EU/EEA-first hosting preference
entries.note: Exact production server location selected for Postqron's infrastructure should be confirmed against live infrastructure configuration before publication.

entries.service: DNS, CDN, edge network and TLS termination
entries.purpose: Deliver, accelerate and protect Postqron's public-facing web traffic
entries.countryOfProcessing: Global edge network; Cloudflare states processing may occur outside the EEA, Switzerland and the United Kingdom depending on the specific services configured
entries.note: Cloudflare also states it complies with the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and is certified to the Global Cross-Border Privacy Rules system as additional transfer safeguards.

entries.service: Transactional email delivery (mailronix.com; account, security and service notifications)
entries.purpose: Send transactional email on Postqron's behalf
entries.countryOfProcessing: Germany (primary infrastructure on Hetzner; email delivery via AWS SES, Frankfurt), per mailronix.com's own published infrastructure statement
entries.dpaReference: https://mailronix.com/terms (Data Processing Agreement stated to be an integral part of these Terms; no separate DPA URL published)
entries.note: Confirmed: Mailronix (mailronix.com) and Postqron are operated by the identical legal entity, Apdsoftware di Carlo Zuffetti, Via C. Colombo 15, 24047 Treviglio (BG), Italia, P.IVA 03835250162 (source: https://mailronix.com/terms, consulted 2026-07-25). Because this is the same legal entity, not an independent third party, this is not an arm's-length subprocessor relationship in the ordinary Art. 28 GDPR sense — an entity cannot be its own sub-processor. This entry is retained under role 'subprocessor' for transparency of the data-flow/technology location only; its precise legal characterization (e.g. as an internal processing location rather than a formal subprocessor) should be finalized by counsel.

entries.legalName: Google LLC (Mountain View, California, USA); Google Ireland Limited (for EEA-relevant purposes)
entries.purpose: Authenticate users who choose to sign in with their Google account
entries.countryOfEstablishment: United States (Google LLC); Ireland (Google Ireland Limited)
entries.countryOfProcessing: Global; Google states data may be processed on servers located outside the user's country
entries.note: Google does not publish a dedicated DPA for Sign in with Google; the applicable terms are the general Google APIs Terms of Service and Google API Services User Data Policy. Google states it is certified to the EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks and the UK Extension, and relies on Standard Contractual Clauses where DPF does not apply (https://policies.google.com/privacy/frameworks).

entries.purpose: Authenticate users who choose to sign in with their Apple ID
dataCategories: email address (or Apple private relay email)
entries.countryOfProcessing: Not verified; not stated on Apple's official Sign in with Apple pages
entries.note: No transfer-mechanism statement (SCCs, adequacy, DPF) was found on Apple's official Sign in with Apple pages as of the consultation date; Apple's general Privacy Policy at apple.com/privacy was not independently reviewed for this purpose and should be checked before publication.

entries.legalName: Meta Platforms, Inc.; Meta Platforms Ireland Limited
entries.service: OAuth login ("Facebook Login") and the customer's own connection to Facebook Pages / Instagram Professional as a publishing destination
entries.purpose: Authenticate users who choose to sign in with Facebook, and let customers publish content to social accounts they connect and authorize themselves
dataCategories: content the customer chooses to publish to their connected Page or Professional account
entries.countryOfEstablishment: Ireland (Meta Platforms Ireland Limited, EEA transfers); United States (Meta Platforms, Inc.)
entries.countryOfProcessing: Not verified; no general storage-location statement found on Meta's official Platform Terms
entries.note: Governed by Meta Platform Terms and Developer Policies, not a dedicated Art. 28 DPA for this login/publishing use case. It was not independently confirmed whether Facebook Pages/Instagram Graph API publishing falls under the Platform Terms or the separate Business Tools Terms; Meta Platforms, Inc. and its wholly-owned US subsidiaries are separately certified to the EU-US and Swiss-US Data Privacy Frameworks.

entries.legalName: LinkedIn Corporation (United States); LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company (for Designated Countries: EU, EEA, Switzerland, UK)
entries.purpose: Authenticate users who choose to sign in with their LinkedIn account
entries.countryOfEstablishment: United States (LinkedIn Corporation); Ireland (LinkedIn Ireland Unlimited Company)
entries.countryOfProcessing: United States; LinkedIn states member data centers are currently located in the U.S.
entries.note: LinkedIn's API Terms of Use cross-reference the LinkedIn Data Processing Agreement for Business Development Agreements (BD DPA) as governing personal information processed under those terms; the BD DPA's own text does not explicitly name OAuth/Sign in with LinkedIn as in-scope, so this applicability is by cross-reference only and not independently confirmed. LinkedIn Corporation is also certified to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
